title: Lights Out
physical_identity: Total darkness and silence in seemingly endless tight hallways of smooth cold material, likely concrete; light sources do not function.
scale_topology: Seemingly endless indoor hallway series; structure barely known; stairwell down to Level 7.
lighting_sound: No light at all; eerily silent like a soundproof room; faint waves near the Level 7 stairwell.
hazards: getting trapped by a wrong turn
items_communities: Mimicry community of about four sound-mimics

exits.conditions: explore deep; wrong turn may block
exits.risk: blocking access and return to Level 5
exits.quote: listen for the faint sound of waves
